edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: Because sorbitol reaches the colon incompletely absorbed, it can change osmotic load and fermentation patterns enough to reshape microbial composition.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2025 Machado meta analysis in Front Microbiomes, which suggests that sorbitol produces mixed findings across studies for gut microbiome diversity. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
